subject: Missing marketplace payout / escrow hold and VAT passthrough guidance
messages:
From: Alex Torres <billing@acme-retail.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Apr 2029 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Missing March marketplace payout (Settlement 48921)

Hi Monica,

We're missing the AWS Marketplace payout that was due on 2029-03-30. On our side, the settlement id 48921 shows an "escrow_hold" flag and the payout amount has been withheld. Attached are: acme_settlement_48921.pdf and merchant_statement_march.csv.

We think this is related to VAT/tax passthrough — our accounting team sent over an EU VAT registration but AWS appears to be requiring additional evidence. Can Redwood confirm whether you see any inbound settlement or hold reason on your side and advise the steps to get this released?

We need funds for supplier payments; any expedited path would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Alex Torres
Head of Finance | Acme Retail Ltd.
billing@acme-retail.com

Attachments: acme_settlement_48921.pdf (pdf), merchant_statement_march.csv (csv)
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Alex Torres <billing@acme-retail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Apr 2029 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Missing March marketplace payout (Settlement 48921)

Hi Alex — thanks for the details and the attachments. I see the settlement in our merchant feed showing status "held - tax mismatch" with an AWS settlement reference. I'm looping in Marissa (Revenue Ops) and Logan (Collections) to triage with me.

Quick asks so we can move fast:
- Can you confirm the VAT registration number and the legal entity that should receive the payout (entity name + tax id)?
- Please confirm whether you have previously submitted a VAT certificate to AWS (and if so, provide the link or a copy).
- If available, upload a copy of the bank remittance advice and the marketplace invoice ID (if different to 48921).

If we can get tax evidence and a signed passthrough declaration, Collections can request AWS to release the hold. I expect a 48-72h turnaround after verification.

I'll create an internal recon and route next steps.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Lead, Marketplace Billing | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

---
Original attachments recorded: acme_settlement_48921.pdf, merchant_statement_march.csv
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2029 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: recon for Settlement 48921 / hold reasons

Monica / Logan — I pulled the internal_recon_48921.xlsx and cross-walked the settlement rows. Notes:
- Marketplace settlement 48921 has an ENTITY_MISMATCH flag (AWS expects VAT ID for the registered seller entity).
- Acme's previously submitted VAT cert (acme_vat_certificate.pdf) is for Acme Retail EU Operations BV; AWS seller account is mapped to Acme Retail Ltd (different entity).
- The settlement pipeline currently requires a passthrough election + proof that the receiving entity is the correct tax subject. AWS legal will process a release only after both: (1) Doc-signed passthrough and (2) confirmation of entity mapping from the merchant bank.

Action items:
1) Logan: initiate collections request to AWS Marketplace to flag the settlement for "expedited review" once we receive DocuSign tax form.
2) Monica: ask Acme to DocSign the passthrough declaration and provide bank remittance evidence.
3) Marissa: prepare a reconciliation memo to attach to the AWS request (I started it in the spreadsheet).

I'll ping AWS settlements contact once we have the doc. ETA: 3 business days after docs complete.

- Marissa
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Torres <billing@acme-retail.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: accounting@acme-retail.com
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2029 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Missing March marketplace payout (Settlement 48921)

Hi Monica — attaching the VAT cert and we've started the DocuSign flow for the passthrough form: https://docsign.com/embedded/45a2b3 (embedded). The VAT reg number is EU-GB987654321. The legal entity for the payout should be Acme Retail Ltd. We also uploaded a remittance file to your S3 share: https://s3.company/recon/acme/settlement_48921.csv.

Can you confirm the exact wording AWS requires on the passthrough? Our legal would like to match it.

Thanks — Alex

Attachments: acme_vat_certificate.pdf
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Alex Torres <billing@acme-retail.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Missing March marketplace payout (Settlement 48921)

Thanks Alex — this is perfect. Marissa, Logan — plan below to release payout:

1) Acme signs passthrough via DocuSign link (Alex confirmed).
2) Marissa will finalize the reconciliation memo (internal_recon_48921.xlsx) and attach the VAT certificate + remittance CSV.
3) Logan will submit an expedited release request to AWS Marketplace with the assembled packet and quote Settlement ID 48921; ask for a payment reference when released.

Timeline: collections will submit today (Thu 04-Apr); AWS estimated review ~48h. If AWS confirms, payout release will show as a manual ACH to Acme's bank within 3 business days.

I'll loop legal if we hit any pushback. Alex — please confirm once DocuSign shows completed and I'll confirm submission to AWS.

Best,
Monica
From: logan_wright@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Alex Torres <billing@acme-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Apr 2029 16:42:00 -07:00

All — quick update: AWS accepted our expedited request at 16:10 UTC and released the hold. They provided release reference AWS-R-20290405-77 and expect funds to clear to Acme's bank account by 2029-04-09. I attached the submission packet for our records.
